conclusion.statement: The cited record contains conflicting Historic Distribution Schedules: one reports the May 22, 2022 distribution as $5,200, Michael T. Hartwell’s share as $1,924, and cumulative distributions as $20,300, while the other reports $4,200, $924, and $19,300, respectively. The other cited materials are excerpts from two K-1s, bylaws, and an incomplete Form 1120-S page; they do not permit a complete reconciliation among books, tax returns, shareholder reporting, corporate resolutions, and bank records.
